description: Product-style photograph of an ornate silver-tone charm necklace displayed on a white jewelry bust against a grey-green background. The long chain carries pearl-like beads and small figural charms (birds and other animals), ending in a large medallion pendant: a central coin bearing a left-facing male profile, ringed by smaller coins and topped by bird figures, with three chain drops below ending in fish charms and a small figure. The central coin's profile is consistent with an Imperial Russian coin (Tsar Nicholas II style) but is not certainly identifiable from the photo.
flags: Central coin identity uncertain — profile consistent with an Imperial Russian coin but not confirmed

description: Screenshot of a GamesBeat/VentureBeat PC Gaming article by Jeff Grubb, dated August 15 2018, headlined about an Xbox Live outage. The header image shows the Xbox sphere logo and 'XBOX LIVE' wordmark over flames. The visible article text reports Microsoft confirmed the outage on its Xbox Live status site and that the outage prevents sign-ins and loading digital purchases. Sidebar shows social share icons, a 2018 Lincoln MKC ad, a 'Most Read' module repeating the same article, and a Chevy Silverado ad.
text: PC GAMING. Xbox Live is down, so how will teens yell at me now?. JEFF GRUBB @JEFFGRUBB AUGUST 15, 2018 5:57 PM. XBOX LIVE. Above: Microsoft's online gaming service is not working for everyone right now. Image Credit: Jeff Grubb/GamesBeat. Xbox Live isn't working for everyone at the moment. Microsoft has confirmed the issue on its Xbox Live status site, and players are complaining about the outage on social media. This is preventing people from signing into Xbox Live, which causes issues loading just about any digital purchase on the platform. If you are unable to sign into Xbox Live, you will have difficulty loading up your downloaded games — although physical discs should still work if you go into. 2018 LINCOLN MKC. THE LINCOLN SUMMER INVITATION SALES EVENT FINAL DAYS. INTRODUCE YOURSELF TO A NEW LINCOLN. DISCOVER MORE. BUILD & PRICE. *Offer disclosure. MOST READ. City labels mark New York, Washington, and Los Angeles; the map carries a MapTiler credit. The map itself does not name the affected service.
